simple.meaning: תַּרְבּוּת (tarbûwth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “multiplication , i.e. progeny.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Numbers, beginning at Numbers 32:14. Its contexts include family, Israel.

definitions.full: H8635. tarbuth תַּרְבּוּת noun feminine increase, brood ; — construct in phrase ׳ת חַטָּאִים אֲנָשִׁים Num 32:14 a brood (contemptuous) of sinful men (compare מַרְבִּית 1Sam 2:33 ).

occurrences.englishText: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.
